pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. A weekly calendar strip with EXACTLY SEVEN equal rectangular day cells in ONE horizontal row. Every cell contains ONE small yellow sun, showing one day. All seven cells are white with gray internal divisions. ONE large thick red outline encloses the ENTIRE seven-day row together, and one red arrow points to the WHOLE row at the center of the outer outline. This image represents an ENTIRE WEEK of seven days, no individual selected day, no red fill in any single cell. No extra cells, rows, headings, writing, dates, lettering or numerals. Fully inside image with ample margins.  Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
